Bash(xargs -I '{}' sh -c 'h=$\(echo {} | cut -d" " -f1\); body=$\(git -C C:/dev/BarberAppointment log -1 --format="%B" $h\); if echo "$body" | grep -qi "claude"; then echo "FOUND in $h"; fi')

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/LeonardoAFer/DynamicAppointment/contributors" -Headers @{ 'User-Agent' = 'claude' }; $r | Select-Object login, id, contributions } catch { $_.Exception.Message })

PowerShell(try { $prs = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/LeonardoAFer/DynamicAppointment/pulls?state=all&per_page=100" -Headers @{ 'User-Agent' = 'claude' }; foreach \($pr in $prs\) { Write-Host "PR #$\($pr.number\) [$\($pr.state\)] by $\($pr.user.login\): $\($pr.title\)" } } catch { $_.Exception.Message })

PowerShell(try { $tags = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/LeonardoAFer/DynamicAppointment/tags?per_page=100" -Headers @{ 'User-Agent' = 'claude' }; if \($tags\) { $tags | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "Tag: $\($_.name\) -> $\($_.commit.sha.Substring\(0,8\)\)" } } else { Write-Host "No tags" } } catch { $_.Exception.Message })

PowerShell(try { $query = '{"query":"{ repository\(owner: \\"LeonardoAFer\\", name: \\"DynamicAppointment\\"\) { mentionableUsers\(first: 50\) { nodes { login name } } collaborators\(first: 50\) { nodes { login name } } } }"}'; $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/graphql" -Method Post -Body $query -ContentType "application/json" -Headers @{ 'User-Agent' = 'claude' }; $r | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 } catch { $_.Exception.Message })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/LeonardoAFer/DynamicAppointment/stats/contributors" -Headers @{ 'User-Agent' = 'claude' }; if \($r\) { $r | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "$\($_.author.login\): $\($_.total\) commits" } } else { Write-Host "Empty/regenerating" } } catch { $_.Exception.Message })
